source_boundaries: JevAdvBench contributes one whole code project; its known dataset, archived pieces, individual outputs and project pages add no further identity.
The new code record retains its original content hash, retrieval time, content-screened tier and no-execution scope. Declared code and data licenses remain separate.
Just Ask Jev is an already-known identity promoted into curated selection and bibliography, with display-only title/scope changes and nine authors retained; it adds zero expansion resources.

The metric comparison preserves typed decision flips versus numerical shifts, clean-conditioned denominators, separate confidence-constrained gate bypass and fresh five-call majority validation. It does not claim caused downstream harm or reproduced attacks.
